_meta.description: [Recruitment] 06 — Offer Gate: Standalone manual webhook trigger. Verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature and routes invalid requests to 202 Accepted (valid) or 403 Rejected before any approval logic runs. Sends Slack approval request via native Send and Wait for Response. On approval: sends personalized offer email via Gmail and logs to Google Sheets. On rejection: sends withdrawal email and logs. Offers NEVER auto-send — explicit human approval required every time. NOT part of the automated scoring/CRM sub-workflow chain.
_meta.validationStatus: PASS — 0 errors. Security hardened: responseMode:responseNode with explicit 403/202 response nodes, future-timestamp replay check, Slack mrkdwn escaping on offerDetails, formula injection strip, HMAC timing-safe comparison with explicit else branch and length invariant comment.
_meta.qaStatus: ALL PASS — PM · Lead n8n Eng · Lead Eng · Design Eng · QA Eng · Best Practices (Batch 7) + Security Review Pass 2
_meta.codeNodeContext: n8n Code nodes use step-through require() pattern; crypto/require calls are runtime n8n sandbox features, not browser scope
securityFixes: F-01: Explicit else { valid = false } on HMAC length-mismatch branch + comment explaining hex-length invariant
F-02: responseMode changed from onReceived to responseNode; added IF:Valid Signature + Respond 403 + Respond 202 nodes — callers now receive explicit 403 on auth failure
F-03: offerDetails sanitized ({{ }} stripping), Slack-escaped (_slackOfferDetails, _slackCandidateName, _slackRoleApplied, _slackClientName) in Normalize node; Slack message uses escaped variants
F-07: Replay protection now rejects both expired (>5 min) AND future-dated (>30s ahead) requestedAt — prevents permanent replay via far-future timestamp
F-08: callerPolicy: workflowsFromSameOwner added to settings
F-09: offerDetails formula injection strip (leading =,+,-,@ prefixed with space) in Normalize node
placeholders: [OFFER_WEBHOOK_SECRET] — replace with your HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Must match the secret used by your recruiter dispatch system to sign offer webhook payloads. Any secure random string (32+ chars recommended).
[SLACK_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n slackApi credential ID. Same credential used in 04-comms-routing.
[SLACK_OPS_CHANNEL_ID] — replace with your Slack channel ID for offer approvals (e.g. C0123456789). The approving recruiter/manager must be in this channel.
[GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n gmailOAuth2 credential ID. Same credential used in 04-comms-routing.
[GOOGLE_SHEETS_CREDENTIAL_ID] — replace with your n8n googleSheetsOAuth2Api credential ID.
[OFFER_LOG_SPREADSHEET_ID] — replace with your Google Sheets spreadsheet ID for the offer log. Find in the sheet URL: /spreadsheets/d/{id}/

[OFFER_LOG_SHEET_NAME] — replace with your sheet tab name (e.g. 'Offers'). Sheet must have headers in row 1: candidate_name, candidate_email, role_applied, client_name, offer_details, decision, offered_at, logged_at

webhookPayloadShape.offerDetails: string (required) — compensation, start date, benefits, any relevant details
webhookPayloadShape.requestedAt: string (required) — ISO 8601 UTC timestamp e.g. '2026-04-13T14:30:00Z'. Requests older than 5 minutes OR more than 30 seconds in the future are rejected for replay protection.

_meta.hmacSignatureFormat: HMAC-SHA256. Header: x-offer-signature: sha256=<hex>. Computed over raw UTF-8 request body string using shared secret. Header name must be lowercase.
_meta.approvalResponseField: $json.data.approved — boolean true (Approved) or false (Rejected) set by Slack sendAndWait node on workflow resume.
_meta.standaloneNote: This workflow is NOT called by any other pipeline workflow. It fires only when a recruiter manually POSTs to the webhook URL. It operates outside the automated scoring and CRM chain.
_meta.responseFlowNote: responseMode:responseNode means: Respond 403 fires on auth failure (caller learns immediately); Respond 202 fires on auth success (closes HTTP connection before Slack sendAndWait begins — prevents caller timeout during long approval wait).
